title: Review of c04's clipped-penalty crawler sweep (negative): three of its settings on fresh seed 3 give extinction, two long-lived crawlers at generation 2, and a boom to a sea that starves down to one body; no sustained crawling division (Supported)
summary: Looked at ocsk/sheet.png, ocs0.2/sheet.png and sw_0.15_0.006/sheet.png, then ran the confound world (20261025T0908-c04-crawler-divide-confound/world.py, which embeds the claim parameters) with WORLD_P bV=1, okclip=1 and three of the sweep's settings on fresh seed 3 (T=600, labkit). shed 0.1: up to 10 bodies, then extinct (0 at t=600), max generation 1. shed 0.2: 2 bodies at the end that crawl up to 18.8 body lengths, 2 persistent splits, max generation 2. kup 0.06, shed 0.1: the founder's progeny fill the domain by t~130, the sheet breaks into ~20 bodies by t~360 and they starve one by one to a single round body at t=600 (rerun_ocsk/seed3/sheet.png), max generation 1. Same three outcomes as the finding on seed 1 (numbers.txt).

observations.D: numbers.txt: max generation 1, 2, 1 at shed 0.1, shed 0.2, kup 0.06 on seed 3; rerun_ocsk/seed3/sheet.png boom, sea, break-up and starvation to one body

controls_run.D: the finding's claim-world reference is in its parent; here the three clipped settings on a new seed

verdicts.limitation: Three of seven settings, one fresh seed; a negative sweep cannot exclude a working setting outside it (the finding names untried directions).
